answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 38535 Country: India Title: Can we use the cow and buffalo urine to spread our paddy fields, farming areas in our acres? Question: Can we use the cow and buffalo urine to spread our paddy fields, farming areas in our acres? Answer ID: 38535 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 911/749/B=1433) The experience shows that the use of dung of cow and buffalo in the fields works as best fertilizer when mixed in the soil. So it is allowed to use it for the same purpose. As far as the matter of urine in the field and agricultural land is concerned then for what purpose it is done? And what is its experience? Explain it then we can write the reply. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
